body: This custom Mercedes Sprinter 170 AWD camper van conversion blends high-performance upgrades with elegant design details to support extended travel, remote work, and rugged overland adventures. Built on the premium El Capitan tier, the van is engineered to handle off-grid living while offering the comforts of a well-appointed tiny home.

Equipped with an 800Ah lithium battery bank, 400W solar system, 3000W pure sine inverter, and a 50A DC-DC charger, this off-grid van build delivers power reliability for full-time living. Climate control is managed through a Nomadic 12V rooftop A/C, Espar diesel heater, and MaxxAir Deluxe fan, ensuring comfort in every season.

Interior features include a queen-size memory foam bed, dual swivel seats, and a convertible Alpine Van Works bench-to-bed system mounted on a swivel base. The wet bath showcases a fully tiled indoor shower, black fixtures, and a Laveo dry flush toilet. A rear-door outdoor shower offers versatility at camp.

The kitchen setup includes an in-counter induction cooktop, acacia butcher block counters, a Zuvo water purification system, and an Isotherm 130L fridge with freezer. A pop-up countertop extension maximizes workspace, and storage is handled with overhead cabinetry, full-length closet, and pull-out trays for easy gear access.

This van also features a CA Tuned bumper with dual Baja Designs LP9 Pro amber lights, an Agile RIP lift kit, all-terrain tires, and a Lost Saguaro rear tire carrier. The Owl Vans B2 bike carrier, Classic Box, and dual 1Up bike trays round out the gear-hauling capability, while a Blackstone electric griddle, folding outdoor table, and full bug screen set make it ideal for long stays in nature.

As with all Papago builds, this Sprinter meets RVIA certification standards, making it eligible for traditional RV financing and built to national safety specifications. This van exemplifies the elevated craftsmanship Papago Vans is known for, merging function, durability, and aesthetic detail into a high-performance overland vehicle.
